mapper.insert: insert into orders (number, status, user_id, address_book_id, order_time, amount, pay_method, remark, phone, address, consignee) values (#{number}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{orderTime}, #{amount}, #{payMethod}, #{remark}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{consignee})
mapper.select: select * from orders where status = #{status} and order_time < #{orderTime}
